original_test_intent: Inject one approved UMC correctable on-die ECC event at address 0x800 into an identified AMD GPU and prove the intended counter/log path detects it while the GPU remains recoverable.
original_method: Bind device0 to serial/UUID/BDF/OAM and confirm subtype2/type2/address semantics with AMD FAE; snapshot module parameters, per-GPU UMC counters, dmesg/SEL/CPER and health without clearing; load/change ras_enable only through approved driver lifecycle; require zero scoped baseline or disposition; inject once; capture return/exit/timestamp; verify exact counter delta and expected correctable UMC messages; check no fatal/XID-like loss; reset/unload/reboot only per approved recovery and verify health.
manual_activity: AMD/FAE authorizes exact injection and driver state; GPU owner isolates the SUT and owns OOB/recovery.
safety_requirements: Abort on uncorrectable/fatal error, GPU loss, hang or threshold
